tools.name: search
tools.description: Find competitions, teams and players on betrend by name (any language, at least 2 characters). Returns each match with its betrend.im URL; pass a competition or team URL to the other tools. Covers sports only.

tools.name: live_scores
tools.description: Matches being played right now on betrend, with the current score and minute or period. Optional filters: sport (e.g. football, cricket, basketball, ice-hockey, tennis, esports) and competition (betrend URL from search). Major competitions come first. Each match has its betrend.im page URL.

tools.name: matches_by_date
tools.description: Fixtures and results on betrend for one UTC calendar day (Y-m-d), from 3 years ago to 14 days ahead. Optional filters: sport, competition and team (betrend URLs from search). Major competitions come first. Each match has its betrend.im page URL.

tools.name: match_details
tools.description: One match on betrend by its URL or slug: teams, status, score, scores by period (halves, quarters, sets, innings, maps), key events such as goals, cards and substitutions, venue, competition, round and kick-off time in UTC. Includes the betrend.im match page URL.

tools.name: standings
tools.description: League table of a competition on betrend: position, played, won, drawn, lost, score for and against, points and recent form for every team, split into groups where the competition has them. Current season by default, or a season such as "2025/26". Includes the betrend.im standings page URL and the l

tools.name: team
tools.description: Overview of a team or player-participant on betrend: country, current competition positions, the last 5 results with W/D/L, and the next 5 fixtures (live matches included). Includes the betrend.im team page URL.

tools.name: head_to_head
tools.description: Past meetings of two teams of the same sport on betrend: number of finished meetings, wins of each team and draws (by team, not home or away), total goals for football, the last 10 results and the next scheduled meeting. Includes the betrend.im head-to-head page URL.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "live_scores" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
